articles.title: "Instalarse, o no, en la excelencia"
articles.standfirst: Nadie puede cuestionar la capacidad goleadora de Mbappé, pero, ¿y su profesionalidad?...
articles.summary: Nadie puede cuestionar la capacidad goleadora de Mbappé, pero, ¿y su profesionalidad?...
articles.body: Es lo que sí ha hecho la selección española. Querer más, no bajar la guardia, pese a haber ganado ya tres títulos con Luis de la Fuente como seleccionador (Nations, Eurocopa y Mundial). Lo escribo porque estos días se está hablando mucho de la profesionalidad de Kylian Mbappé en este parón de selecciones. El delantero francés se lesionó en el estreno de Zidane en el banquillo de ‘Les bleus’ y, en vez de regresar a Madrid, se quedó en París para que le viera la rodilla su médico de confianza (con la connivencia del club) y, para que le vieran también con su novia Ester Expósito en una de las discotecas más de moda de la capital francesa. Hubiese sido mucho más profesional regresar cuanto antes al trabajo en Valdebebas. El problema no es de Kylian, es de quién se lo permite y, en este sentido, este Mourinho no es el de hace 13 años por más que haya empezado ya con los papelitos y sus quejas arbitrales en sala de prensa. El Real estuvo siete años detrás de Mbappé pero no se hizo con un líder, sino con un extraordinario goleador. Sus cifras de blanco son increíbles, pero no ha tenido acierto en los partidos importantes (algunos se los perdió por lesión, previo paseo también con su novia por París) y su vacío de títulos con el Madrid ha coincidido ‘casual’ o ‘causalmente’ con dos Champions seguidas del PSG, el club que dejó por cumplir su sueño de infancia. El galo tiene que instalarse en la excelencia y dar ejemplo no sólo sobre el césped. Si no, su propia tía abuela se acabará enfadando también con él. Aprende de España, ‘Kiki’.

articles.standfirst: Los Flores, Juanjo y Alberto, germinaron en Zubieta con un gran encuentro
articles.summary: Los Flores, Juanjo y Alberto, germinaron en Zubieta con un gran encuentro
articles.body: Tras cuatro jornadas sin ganar, Pacheta necesitaba soluciones y ante la Real Sociedad B acometió una revolución, cambiando el dibujo e introduciendo cinco novedades en el once. Los cambios, en su gran mayoría, no fueron efectivos, a excepción de la presencia de Alberto Flores y Juanjo Flores, que exprimieron al máximo su oportunidad, demostrando que están preparados para ser importantes en este equipo. Alberto Flores desembarcó en Los Cármenes con ambición, dispuesto a ponerle las cosas difíciles a Lizoain. El portero canario fue el elegido por Pacheta para iniciar como titular el curso, lo que obligaba al hispalense a esperar paciente su momento, una coyuntura que apareció ante la Real Sociedad B. Después de varios encuentros en los que Lizoain no mostró su mejor nivel, el preparador rojiblanco decidió rotar en la portería, una apuesta que surtió el efecto deseado. Flores destiló seguridad y durante la primera parte mantuvo con vida a los andaluces, evitando que los donostiarras ampliasen aún más la ventaja. En el segundo acto, con menos trabajo, el sevillano también fue decisivo con varias intervenciones salvadoras, contribuyendo de forma sustancial a la remontada. Por lo ofrecido ante el Sanse, todo apunta a que Flores seguirá defendiendo la portería de los rojiblancos en los próximos encuentros, intercambiando los papeles con Lizoain, al que ahora le tocará apretar los dientes para intentar recuperar su puesto en el once. La oportunidad para Juanjo Flores también llegó en San Sebastián. El central, después de madurar durante el curso pasado bajo la tutela de Pacheta, mostró su nivel en las últimas jornadas de la pasada campaña, dejando claro que estaba listo para dar el salto al primer equipo. Tras sus buenas actuaciones, todo apuntaba a que su papel este año sería importante, pero de forma inesperada el técnico rojiblanco optó por Bourama y Gimber, dejando al sevillano en el fondo de la rotación. Fiel a su carácter, Flores siguió trabajando sin descanso, aguardando sin desesperar hasta que la puerta se volvió a abrir. Ante el Sanse, el joven zaguero desplegó sus virtudes, mostrándose como un defensa siempre concentrado, sin conceder facilidades al rival, completando una actuación convincente que le devuelve al primer plano convertido en candidato a acompañar a Lama en el centro de la zaga nazarí.

articles.title: La 'rebelión' de las bicicletas: ahora es Militao el que sube una foto montando
articles.standfirst: El brasileño posteó una foto dando un paseo con su mujer
articles.summary: El brasileño posteó una foto dando un paseo con su mujer
articles.body: El video de Mbappé montando en bicicleta sigue dando que hablar. Tras la polémica que se generó uniéndolo a las palabras de Mourinho diciendo que los futbolistas no podían "ni montar en bicicleta ni esquiar", ahora ha sido Militao el que ha hecho un guiño a su compañero subiendo a sus redes una foto dando un paseo en bicicleta junto a su esposa. El Real Madrid sigue preparando el partido ante el Villarreal, para el que el club espera a Kylian Mbappé totalmente recuperado. Militao, lesionado de larga duración, aspira a entrar en su primera lista de convocados del curso, toda vez que ya está trabajando con el grupo.

articles.title: Messi’s former Barcelona teammate Pedro retires at 39 after glittering 25-trophy career
articles.summary: A day after Lionel Messi bid an emotional farewell to international football, his former Barcelona teammate Pedro Rodriguez has also called time on his
articles.body: A day after Lionel Messi bid an emotional farewell to international football, his former Barcelona teammate Pedro Rodriguez has also called time on his illustrious career, with the Spain great retiring at the age of 39 after winning 25 major trophies.Pedro, who played alongside Messi during Barcelona’s golden era, announced his retirement on Wednesday, bringing the curtain down on a 20-year career that saw him lift the FIFA World Cup, UEFA European Championship and Champions League.The Tenerife-born forward had been a free agent since leaving Lazio when his contract expired in July. He said he felt the time was right to begin a new chapter after a career that took him from Barcelona’s academy to the summit of European and international football.“I feel it is time. The time to take a step forward and begin a new chapter in my life,” Pedro said in a statement on social media.“I leave proud of having lived my dream and of all the people who stood by my side to make it a reality. Thank you, football, for making me so happy.”World Cup, Euro and Champions League gloryPedro broke into Barcelona’s first team in 2008 and became a key member of Pep Guardiola’s outstanding side. He won 20 major trophies with the Catalan giants before moving to Chelsea in 2015.One of the defining moments of his Barcelona career came in the 2011 Champions League final at Wembley, when Pedro opened the scoring in a 3-1 victory over Manchester United.He was also part of the Barcelona side that completed an extraordinary sextuple in 2009. During the 2009-10 season, Pedro became the first player to score in all six official competitions contested by the club in a single campaign — La Liga, Copa del Rey, Champions League, Spanish Super Cup, European Super Cup and Club World Cup.At Chelsea, Pedro added the Premier League title to his collection during the 2016-17 season.His international career was equally decorated.Pedro was a key member of Spain’s squad that won the 2010 World Cup in South Africa, starting the final as Spain defeated the Netherlands 1-0 after extra time. Two years later, he helped La Roja win Euro 2012.794 club appearances, 25 major trophiesAfter leaving Chelsea, Pedro spent a season at Roma before crossing the Italian capital to join Lazio. He spent the final five years of his career with the club before becoming a free agent in July.Across his club career, Pedro made 794 appearances and scored 197 goals. He also represented Spain 65 times, scoring 17 goals.His trophy cabinet includes 25 major honours, headlined by a World Cup, European Championship and three Champions League titles.Pedro's retirement comes just one day after Messi, his former Barcelona teammate and one of the central figures of his greatest years at Camp Nou, played his final match for Argentina.Together, they were part of a Barcelona side that dominated European football and collected trophies under Guardiola and his successors.Now, with Messi having closed one chapter of his international career and Pedro ending his own 20-year journey in the game, another member of Barcelona's golden generation has taken his final bow.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Falcons Have Perfect Clapback to ESPN Doubters After Monday Night Football
articles.summary: The Atlanta Falcons had the perfect response to ESPN’s doubters after their dominant Monday night victory over the New Orleans Saints. Atlanta let its perfor...
articles.body:
The Atlanta Falcons had the perfect response to ESPN's doubters after their dominant Monday night victory over the New Orleans Saints. Atlanta let its performance do the talking, turning a game in which most predictions favored New Orleans into a convincing 45-24 win.

The predictions had the Saints entering the matchup as the more likely team to come out on top. Scott Van Pelt picked New Orleans to win 27-20, while Pat McAfee predicted a 27-26 Saints victory, Marcus Spears had the Saints winning 28-24 and Jason Kelce projected a 27-24 New Orleans win. Jason McCourty was the lone analyst to pick Atlanta, giving the Falcons a narrow 28-25 victory, while 60% of fans also sided with the Saints.

Instead, Atlanta quickly showed why preseason and pregame predictions do not always tell the full story. The Falcons controlled the game on both sides of the ball, scoring 45 points while piling up 420 total yards and five rushing touchdowns in a performance that left little doubt about which team was superior.

Bijan Robinson played a major role in the offensive explosion, putting together one of his strongest performances of the season. The running back consistently created problems for New Orleans and helped Atlanta establish control on the ground, allowing the Falcons to dictate the tempo while taking pressure off quarterback Michael Penix Jr.

Atlanta Falcons React to ESPN Doubters After Monday Night Football Win

Atlanta clapped back at several ESPN analysts after they favored the Saints during Week 4. This can be seen in a post shared by the team's official X account.

The defense also delivered a statement of its own by limiting the Saints' rushing attack and preventing New Orleans from finding any sustained rhythm. Atlanta held the Saints to just 2.6 yards per carry, continuing a strong stretch after allowing the Green Bay Packers only 1.9 yards per carry in Week 3. The Falcons also finished the night without committing a turnover, adding to a remarkably efficient performance.

For Atlanta, the victory was more than another win on the schedule because it provided a response to those who expected the Saints to prevail. The Falcons now have momentum heading into their next challenge, and if they continue playing with this level of balance and physicality, they could quickly become one of the NFC South's most dangerous teams.

articles.title: Will weather impact the Georgia-Alabama game? Officials keeping close eye on Isaias
articles.summary: Georgia and Alabama prepare for their top-10 clash while officials monitor Tropical Storm Isaias for potential disruptions.
articles.body:
One of the biggest games of the college football season is still on track to be played Saturday night, but all eyes are on more than just the action on the field.

No. 2 Georgia is set to travel to Tuscaloosa to face No. 6 Alabama in a top-10 SEC showdown that could have major implications for the conference title race and College Football Playoff picture.

The matchup is widely considered the marquee game of Week 6 and features two undefeated teams entering the weekend.

But a developing tropical system in the Gulf could create challenges for fans traveling to the game and potentially impact conditions inside Bryant-Denny Stadium.

Tropical Storm Isaias formed in the Gulf this week and forecasters say it could strengthen into the season's first Atlantic hurricane before reaching the northern Gulf Coast.

Forecast models show the storm bringing heavy rain, gusty winds and the possibility of severe weather across parts of Alabama and Georgia heading into the weekend.

The University of Alabama released a statement Tuesday night saying athletics officials are closely monitoring the forecast.

"At this time, there are no plans to alter the contest," the statement said. Officials added they will continue coordinating with the Southeastern Conference and monitoring weather conditions throughout the week.

That message was echoed in a graphic shared by Alabama Athletics, which encouraged fans to rely on official Alabama Athletics and SEC channels for updates regarding Saturday's game.

The SEC also said it is keeping a close eye on forecasts and staying in communication with schools that could be affected by weather.

The uncertainty has sparked discussion about contingency plans should the forecast worsen.

Weather experts have said the possibility of rescheduling or relocating the game has been considered if hurricane conditions threaten the area, though recent forecast updates have shifted the projected track farther east and improved the outlook for playing the game as scheduled.

Even if the game kicks off as planned, weather could still play a role. Forecasts have suggested periods of heavy rain and strong winds are possible in Tuscaloosa on Saturday, conditions that could affect travel and potentially influence play on the field.

For Georgia fans making the trip west and Alabama fans headed to campus, officials are urging everyone to closely monitor forecasts in the days leading up to kickoff.

As of Wednesday, the game remains scheduled for Saturday night in Tuscaloosa, with the Bulldogs and Crimson Tide preparing for another high-stakes chapter in one of college football's biggest modern rivalries.

The Associated Press contributed to this article.

articles.title: How to watch Arsenal vs Leeds live: Stream, TV, team news, prediction
articles.summary: The Gunners are no longer perfect on the season and have had weeks to stew on their space three points below Manchester City.
articles.body:
Arsenal look to keep the early season table race hot when they welcome upstart Leeds United to the Emirates Stadium on Saturday.

The Gunners are no longer perfect on the season and have had weeks to stew on their space three points below Manchester City.

Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta has signed a new deal with the club and will look to push his team toward another Premier League title and more, so slipping further off the pace at home to Leeds would not be welcome.

Leeds remain unbeaten with two wins and three draws through Week 5, as Daniel Farke has driven his team into the top five, just three points off second-place Arsenal.

Below you'll find details on how to watch the game, team news, and a prediction.

How to watch Arsenal vs Leeds live, stream link and start time

Kick off time : 7:30am ET Saturday, October 10 Venue : Emirates Stadium — North London TV Channel : USA Stream link : Watch on USA

Arsenal have been led by Bukayo Saka's three goals this season, and he's tops on the team in xG and second in xA. Martin Odegaard has created 12 chances this season in 382 minutes, tied for sixth-most in the league.

William Saliba remains out while the statuses of three defenders — Ezri Konsa, Ben White, and Cristhian Mosquera — are in question. Christos Tzolis is expected to miss and Kai Havertz is a bit of a longshot, while Declan Rice should be good to go but Arteta may be cautious with good depth and the player's hamstring injury. Max Dowman also took a knock before the break.

Leeds have been solid at both ends, with new center back Tarik Muharemovic off to an exceptional start in front of James Trafford. Anton Stach is starring as a playmaker, and Dominic Calvert-Lewin's three goals lead the way.

Leeds' injury list is shorter than the Gunners' notepad. Mateo Joseph and Joe Rodon are out, while Harry Wilson misses Wales duty but could be ready to go. Jean-Matteo Bahoya is a question.

This should be a very good match-up depending on Arsenal's injury list. Crazy things can happen out of an international break and Arsenal had more players traveling than the visitors. Maybe? Arsenal 1-1 Leeds .

articles.title: Barcelona scout €60m-rated Premier League teenager; Chelsea, Liverpool also keen – report
articles.summary: According to reports in England, as relayed by Mundo Deportivo, FC Barcelona have reportedly joined the long list of clubs interested in Josh King of Fulham....
articles.body:
According to reports in England, as relayed by Mundo Deportivo , FC Barcelona have reportedly joined the long list of clubs interested in Josh King of Fulham.

Indeed, as per the report, Barça scouts have watched the 19-year-old midfielder on several occasions during the 2026/27 season and have been particularly impressed by his performances.

King, a product of the Fulham youth academy, has made an impressive start to the campaign.

In his five Premier League appearances, he has already scored twice and also provided one assist in his solitary Carabao Cup game, establishing himself as one of the standout players in a side that has struggled during the opening weeks of the season.

In all, the English midfield prospect has made 55 first-team appearances for the Cottagers since his senior debut back in 2024.

On Barcelona's radar. (Photo by Julian Finney/Getty Images)

He has also played nine matches for the England U-21 national team, even finding the back of the net on one occasion.

Naturally, his breakthrough performances have led to attention from top clubs across Europe, including Barcelona.

The reigning La Liga champions are currently among the clubs showing the strongest interest and could even consider making an offer next summer.

According to the report, however, the likes of Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester United, Borussia Dortmund, RB Leipzig, Inter Milan and Atletico Madrid are also following the teenage midfielder's progress.

No immediate plans of a move from Barcelona. (Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images)

King is under contract with Fulham until 2029 and is valued at around €60 million.

However, the Blaugrana are not currently considering spending that amount on the player, either in January or during next summer's transfer window.

There has been no direct contact between Barcelona and King beyond the scouting activity. The Catalan club are understood to be interested in assessing the midfielder's development rather than preparing an immediate move.

His profile fits Barça's strategy of identifying young players with room to develop , but the club do not intend to make an operation that falls outside their financial limits.

For now, Barcelona's interest is focused on one question: how far Josh King can progress.
